Hi, I'm Carina.  I'm on the lookout for a Co-creator/CTO.

🚀  Riofie Competition Co-creator/CTO Wanted — a living universe where visionary creators meet technology, and ideas dance across the cosmos.

If you love building from 0 to 1 — and want to explore alongside co-creators of a new paradigm — this might just be your universe.

✨ Join Riofie → Click and scroll to the bottom for two key links:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1fiM2R0d0MMejKn5Uxn_mCQHwsMUwD7LS/view?usp=sharing

🎥 Watch the intro video to see what we’re building.
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xI5mbnEPIxZtsGngZOA6rfZAfpOxoaDU/view?usp=sharing

✨ We’re also open to co-creators with other skill sets, as well as investors or donors who share this vision. Feel free to share with anyone who should see this!
